why: Each eye takes 1 pearl + 1 blaze powder, so 11 eyes need 11 powder. You have 1 powder, and your 2 rods make 4 more: 5. You need 6 more powder, and each rod gives 2, so 3 more rods.
trap: 9 (one rod per eye, minus the 2 held), 4 (forgets the loose powder), or 5 (forgets the rods already held).

techniques.description: 1 rod = 2 powder; count held rods and powder.
techniques.source: https://minecraft.wiki/w/Blaze_Powder (raw line 12: Output Blaze Powder,2); https://minecraft.wiki/w/Eye_of_Ender (recipe)
